namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs its page objects into. It is the RBAC boundary the chart exists for — a group with no RoleBinding here cannot `list` the page roots, so the portal sidebar never shows them and the page body 403s on a deep link. The release itself stays wherever the composition is created; only the page objects live here.
namespace.title: namespace

dataNamespace.description: Namespace holding the clickhouse-endpoint Secret these pages read telemetry through — the DATA, not the pages.
dataNamespace.title: dataNamespace

readerGroups.description: Groups granted read of these pages in `namespace`. A group listed here sees /observability in the sidebar and can open it; a group absent cannot list the page roots, so the entry never renders. `devs` is deliberately NOT a default — keeping it out is the point of the split (#261).
readerGroups.title: readerGroups

portalNamespace.description: The portal's own namespace. These pages reference three objects that deliberately STAY with the portal — the `stat-healthy` and `stat-failed` Statistic widgets and the `compositions-list` RESTAction, all of which the tenant-facing Dashboard also uses — so the refs point here rather than carrying duplicates.
portalNamespace.title: portalNamespace

observabilityConsoleUrl.description: Optional URL of the external observability console. When set, a "View in console" link appears; empty hides it.
observabilityConsoleUrl.title: observabilityConsoleUrl

observability.description: The snowplow SLI sub-page. 74 of this chart's templates are gated on it and render nothing when it is off, which is the default.
observability.title: observability
